request.description: Whether to launch a new process or attach to a running one.

program.description: Path to the application assembly (.dll) or apphost executable to launch.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program.

env.description: Environment variables for the program, for example ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT.

stopAtEntry.description: Stop at the program's entry point.

justMyCode.description: Only step through and break in user code.
